Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TABLE, POSTMORTEM 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for postmortem table. 

2. Material 

2.1 Frameworii — As given in 2.1 of IS : 4033-1968 ' General requirements for hospital furniture '. 

2.2 fop — Stainless steel sheet conforming to Designation 04Cr18 NilO or 07Cr18 Ni9 of (8:6911-1972 
' Specification for stainless steel plate sheet and strip '. The finished thickness shall be not less 
than 91 mm at any point. 

2.3 Sti09$ — Aluminium alloy for ordinary and stainless steel for adjustable levelling shoes. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

4. IManufacture and Workmanship 

4.1 The postmortem table shall have a welded framework of continuous lengths of mild steel tubes as 
shown in Fig. 1 . 

4.2 The four upright members shall be connected near the floor by a pair of longitudinal and a pair of 
transverse tubes. 

4.3 The upright members shall support a formed metal top having a drainage tube as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.4 The arrangement for welding the top and the upright members may be employed but the construction 
so obtained shall be sturdy and sound. 

4.5 The table shall be free from burrs and sharp edges. 

4.6 The upright members shall be fitted with either ordinary aluminium shoes or with adjustable stainless 
steel shoes. The shoes shall be of such a design so that they can be inserted in the pipe and then 
secured or rivetted. 

4.7 The table shall also conform to the requirements laid down in 4.1 of IS : 4033*1968. 

4.8 The top of the table shall be sloping to facilitate drainage into the drain hole. 

5. Finish —As specified in 5 of IS : 4033-1968. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Adiiesion Test — As prescribed in 6.1.1 of IS: 4033-1968. 

7. Marking — As given in 7.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 



Adopted 24 August 1982 



(October 1982, BIS
